Name: Duruznik's Vanilla Portraits
Author: Duruznik
Description:
Custom portraits for all the characters in my own style! Including all minor characters, winter and beach outfits, the works.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

1. You will need to have [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b] [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b] [/url]installed. 
2. This is a hi-res mod, which means you'll need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999][b]Portraiture[/b][/url] installed as well.
3. Simply download the file and drop it into your mods folder.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

Using Portraiture is really simple! When you're talking to an NPC, simply press 'P' to cycle between vanilla portraits and modded ones. Once you've selected one of my portraits, the game will remember your choice for all NPCs.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

Coming soon! I'd like to eventually have support for major expansions like SVE as well as seasonal variants and other custom NPCs!

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

Massive shoutout to the modding art community in the official Stardew Discord! Without y'all, this mod would've never seen the light of day.

And an extra loud shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DacarTheGorilla]Dacar[/url] for all the help with coding and setup!
